create_tree_cast_like: cast a pytree to the dtypes of another reference pytree using tree_cast_like
create_tree_cast: cast all leaves of a pytree to a specified dtype, skipping if dtype is None
test_tree_dtype: test the tree_dtype function to fetch the common dtype of a pytree with mixed_dtype_handler options
review_tree_dtype: review the tree_dtype function and its mixed_dtype_handler modes: promote, highest, lowest
summarize_tree_cast: summarize the tree_cast and tree_cast_like utilities for casting pytree leaves to target dtypes
